items.t: 2.4L engine burns oil (warranty extension)
items.job: Oil consumption test; replace engine long block if it fails
items.note: Low end is just the consumption test. Covered by the 7-year/100,000-mile extension on eligible 2015-2018 vehicles.

items.t: Radiator cooling fan fails and engine overheats (notice V54)
items.job: Replace engine cooling fan assembly
items.note: Free under Customer Satisfaction Notification V54; FCA reimbursed owners with receipts.

items.t: Coolant loss and overheating
items.job: Find leak; replace thermostat housing or heater core
items.note: A thermostat job is near the low end; a heater core behind the dash is near the high end.

items.t: Misfire and rough running from ignition coil boots (TSB)
items.job: Replace all four ignition coil boots (bulletin 08-027-20)
items.note: Bulletin labor is 0.5 hours. A failed coil adds parts cost.

items.t: Jerking or limp mode with code P2173 (TSB)
items.job: Install modified oil vapor inlet tube (bulletin 09-010-20)

items.t: Cranks but won't start in freezing weather (muffler TSB)
items.job: Drill a drain hole in the muffler (bulletin 09-004-20)

items.t: Squealing brakes and rusty front rotors
items.job: Front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Transmission may shift to neutral without warning (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine and transmission computers; replace range sensor harness if needed

items.t: Cracked oil pump housing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace oil pump / balance shaft module

items.t: Fuel pump may lose pressure and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump

items.t: Engine computer chip failure (recall)
items.job: Replace powertrain control module

items.t: Trailer hitch may be missing bolts (recall)
items.job: Install additional hitch fasteners

items.t: Radio software could allow remote hacking (recall)
items.job: Update radio software

items.t: Many warning lights come on with no fault (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software

items.t: Airbag controller software may disable safety systems (recall)
items.job: Update or replace occupant restraint controller

items.t: Backup camera image stays on after reverse (recall)
items.job: Update radio software

items.t: Rear brake caliper may be cracked (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace right rear brake caliper

items.t: Seat belt buckle sensor may stop the front airbag (recall)
items.job: Repair seat belt buckle switch connection

items.t: Wrong reverse light assembly installed (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace bumper reverse light

items.t: Rough, jerky or delayed shifting from the 9-speed automatic
items.job: Reprogram the transmission control module with the latest software
items.note: Jeep bulletin 21-040-17 allows 0.2 hours for the reprogram; shops usually add a diagnostic fee. Owners report that most shift complaints were fixed with software, but a valve body or internal repair costs far more and is often done under warranty.

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body
items.note: Based on estimators because no parts-catalog price was found. RepairPal: $391-$420 total for 2015-2021 ($597-$637 for 2022). YourMechanic: about $908 average (parts $768, labor $140). The low parts figure is RepairPal total minus about one hour of labor. Stalling has several causes, so have the codes read first; a software update or fuel-system fix costs differently.

items.t: A/C blows warm from a refrigerant leak
items.job: Replace leaking A/C suction hose or condenser, then evacuate and recharge
items.note: YourMechanic averages: suction (low-pressure) hose about $279 (parts $108, labor $171); condenser about $451 (parts $318, labor $133). Its 2018 shop/dealer ranges run about $460-$670 for the hose and $940-$1,460 for the condenser.

items.t: Creak or rattle from the front suspension (TSB)
items.job: Fit sleeves to both front coil springs and align (bulletin 02-009-17)
items.note: Bulletin labor is 2.6 hours, including a front wheel alignment. The bulletin does not list a price for the two spring sleeves (part 68415377AA), so ask the shop to quote them.
